whyItIsWrong: The model worked by the learned methods in every run read, and chose not to where one did not apply, yet the ledger said no method was ever used: `invoked` counts a session opening the method, and a body already inlined in the prompt is never opened. The same inlining presented EviMed's inference as the researcher's own rule ranked above the capability, and the model followed it over the capability where they disagreed.
fix: A learned method travels as a card naming its file (packages/socket/src/learnedMethods.mjs) and is opened when it applies; opening it with `read` or a reading shell program is `invoked` (apps/server/src/methodObservations.mjs).
